scenes.text: Myth or fact? You can't get sun damage through a window.
Most windows block UVB, but UVA gets through. UVA is the light linked to dark spots and early wrinkles.
scenes.head: UVA gets through.

scenes.text: Sitting by a window all day? Wear sunscreen.

caption:
Can the sun reach your skin through a window? ☀️
Yes. Most glass blocks UVB, but UVA gets through, and UVA is the light linked to dark spots and early wrinkles. Window seat all day? Wear sunscreen.
Send this to your friend who works by the window.
